description: This file contains functions that handle platform-specific operations for upgrading device firmware and partition management on OpenWRT, including image verification, copying configurations, and flashing partition tables.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the partition layout of a device matches the image, warning if it has changed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to a mounted partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by writing images, updating partition tables, and flashing bootloader.
